findings.name: HTML escaping disabled (glide.ui.escape_text)
findings.description: HTML output escaping is disabled, allowing stored/reflected XSS attacks.
findings.recommendation: Set glide.ui.escape_text to true to enable global HTML output escaping.

findings.name: Jelly HTML escaping disabled
findings.description: Jelly template HTML escaping is disabled, allowing XSS through server-side templates.
findings.recommendation: Set glide.ui.escape_all_script to true.

findings.name: Strict Content-Security-Policy header missing
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy header is configured, reducing defense-in-depth against XSS.
findings.recommendation: Configure a strict CSP header via glide.http.content_security_policy.

findings.name: Session timeout too long
findings.description: Session timeout of 8 hours exceeds best practice of 30 minutes for idle sessions.
findings.recommendation: Set glide.ui.session_timeout to 30 or less.

findings.name: Absolute session timeout not enforced
findings.description: No absolute session timeout forces re-authentication regardless of activity.
findings.recommendation: Set glide.ui.session_absolute_timeout to 480 (8 hours).

findings.name: Session cookies lack Secure flag
findings.description: Session cookies transmitted over HTTP can be intercepted.
findings.recommendation: Set glide.cookies.secure to true to enforce HTTPS-only cookies.

findings.name: Session fixation protection disabled
findings.description: Session IDs not regenerated on login enables session fixation attacks.
findings.recommendation: Set glide.security.session.regenerate_on_login to true.

findings.name: SSO not enabled
findings.description: Single Sign-On is not configured, users authenticate with local passwords only.
findings.recommendation: Enable SSO integration with your corporate IdP (Okta, Azure AD, etc.).

findings.name: Password complexity requirements too weak
findings.description: Minimum password length of 6 is below the recommended 12+ characters.
findings.recommendation: Set glide.security.password.min_length to at least 12.

findings.name: Account lockout threshold too high
findings.description: Account lockout after 20 failed attempts allows extensive brute-force attempts.
findings.recommendation: Set lockout threshold to 5 or fewer attempts.

findings.name: Failed login lockout duration too short
findings.description: 1-minute lockout is too short to deter automated attacks.
findings.recommendation: Set lockout duration to at least 15 minutes (900 seconds).

findings.name: ACL enforcement disabled for specific tables
findings.code: 3 ACLs with active=false on sensitive tables (sys_user, sys_user_has_role)
findings.description: Disabled ACLs on user/role tables allow unauthorized data access.
findings.recommendation: Re-enable ACLs on all sensitive tables and verify rule logic.

findings.name: Excessive admin role assignments
findings.description: Too many users have the admin role, increasing blast radius of compromised accounts.
findings.recommendation: Review admin role assignments. Implement least-privilege with custom roles.

findings.name: Elevated roles assigned to integration users
findings.code: Integration users with admin: svc_integration, svc_ldap_sync
findings.description: Service accounts with admin roles can be exploited if credentials are compromised.
findings.recommendation: Create dedicated roles for integrations with minimum required permissions.

findings.name: Encryption at rest not enabled
findings.description: Database encryption at rest is not enabled, risking data exposure if storage is compromised.
findings.recommendation: Enable column-level encryption for sensitive fields and full database encryption.

findings.name: Attachment download unrestricted
findings.description: No MIME type validation on file downloads allows serving of malicious content.
findings.recommendation: Enable MIME type validation and restrict allowed file types.

findings.name: Debug mode enabled in production
findings.description: Debug mode exposes internal details that assist attackers in reconnaissance.
findings.recommendation: Disable debug mode (glide.debug.active = false) in production.

findings.name: HTTP Strict Transport Security missing
findings.description: Without HSTS, users may connect over HTTP and be susceptible to MITM attacks.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS with glide.security.hsts.enabled = true.

findings.name: Audit logging not enabled for all tables
findings.description: Many sensitive tables are not audited, making incident investigation incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Enable audit logging on all tables containing PII, credentials, or security settings.

findings.name: Login audit trail retention too short
findings.description: 30-day audit retention may not meet compliance requirements (typically 90+ days).
findings.recommendation: Set audit log retention to at least 90 days, or forward to SIEM for long-term storage.

findings.name: CSRF protection not enforced
findings.description: CSRF tokens not required, allowing cross-site request forgery attacks.
findings.recommendation: Enable CSRF protection with glide.security.csrf.enabled = true.

findings.name: REST API rate limiting not configured
findings.description: No rate limiting on REST API allows abuse and potential denial of service.
findings.recommendation: Configure REST API rate limiting per user/IP.

findings.name: SOAP API endpoints publicly accessible
findings.description: Unauthenticated SOAP API access exposes instance data.
findings.recommendation: Require authentication for all SOAP API endpoints.

findings.name: Stale user accounts detected
findings.description: 5 users have not logged in for over 90 days and still have active accounts.
findings.recommendation: Disable or deactivate stale accounts. Implement automated user lifecycle management.
